sloka: एभिः प्रधर्षिताश्चैव वानरा वनरक्षिभिः ।मधून्यचिन्तयित्वेमान् भक्षयन्ति पिबन्ति च ।। ५.६३.५ ।।।।
transliteration: ebhiḥ pradharṣitāścaiva vānarā vanarakṣibhiḥ ।madhūnyacintayitvemān bhakṣayanti pibanti ca ।। 5.63.5 ।।।।

translations.english: "Even though the garden guards forcibly tried to prevent them they did not care and have devoured all the honey.
